judge.why: The tutor never asked what the learner already knew. Its first message laid out the whole resolution, including that this happens in every language, that 0.1 isn't stored exactly, and the 1/3 analogy, before the learner had reasoned anything out. Each later turn was a long lecture ending in a prediction question, so the learner mostly confirmed ideas they'd been handed rather than discovering them, even though the follow-up challenges were accurate and well chosen.
